title: Meera's trading and profit and loss account
body: Meera runs a stationery trading business. The following balances relate to the year ended March 31, 2026: Opening stock Rs 30,000; Purchases Rs 2,00,000; Purchases return Rs 8,000; Sales Rs 3,60,000; Sales return Rs 10,000; Wages Rs 22,000; Carriage inwards Rs 6,000; Salaries Rs 25,000; Rent of office Rs 12,000; Carriage outwards Rs 4,000; Commission received Rs 3,000. Stock on March 31, 2026 was valued at Rs 40,000. Meera's accountant wants to prepare the trading and profit and loss account, treating wages and carriage inwards as direct expenses and salaries, office rent and carriage outwards as indirect expenses.
